content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP), fallback-level cure.**

- **What exists:** Section 9 (p0090) is mutual and already excepts "Section 8" — which in this document is the **INDEMNIFICATION** section (p0085–p0088), so indemnities sit outside the cap. The mutual indirect/consequential exclusion is intact.
- **Why it fails fallback:** (1) the cap is not 12 months' fees but only amounts paid "for the transaction which the liability relates to" in that window — a per-transaction slice that can fall below even 6 months' fees; (2) no carve-out for confidentiality (Section 10 sits inside the cap), gross negligence or wilful misconduct — neither phrase appears anywhere in the agreement.
- **Cure:** one surgical replace in p0090 — deleted the transaction narrowing and extended the existing exception opener to cover confidentiality breach, gross negligence and wilful misconduct. Preferred-only items (USD 1m floor, "paid or payable", data-protection/IP/fraud carve-outs, payment-obligation exclusion) were noted in the rationale, not drafted in.
